entities.summary: Aban Marker Kabraji, is a Pakistani biologist and scientist of Parsi origin. She was regional director of the Asia Regional Office of IUCN, the International Union for Conservation of Nature, until early 2021 when she retired from her position. Previously, she was country representative for the IUCN Pakistan office.
